How the voice picks were made

One pair, one-to-one

GoogleElevenLabsPrice per minute of speech
Gemini 3.8 Flash TTSEleven v4 NEW eleven_v4~$0.014 vs ~$0.07
  • The 9 October call asked for Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS against ElevenLabs, with an Indian-language view for the Indian market.
  • Eleven v4 (28 September) is ElevenLabs’ newest and highest-quality model. It replaces the v3 we used in September. Eleven v4 Turbo is the low-latency version, aimed at live agents.
  • Prices are estimates from list rates. Gemini charges $9 per million audio tokens (about 25 tokens a second). ElevenLabs charges $0.08 per 1,000 characters (about 15 characters a second). ElevenLabs has a 72% launch discount until 12 October.

Languages

LanguageWhat it isPickedAvailable
  • English and Hindi–English lead (135 of 200), as decided on the 9 October call.
  • Hindi and Hinglish are told apart by script. Hindi scripts are in Devanagari. Hinglish scripts are in Roman letters, or mix the two scripts. Both carry English words, as real Indian call-centre speech does.
  • Telugu is kept small. The bank has only 9 Telugu-script scenarios, and all 9 are in. Tenglish (Telugu in Roman letters) gets 6.

The 60 new English scenarios

  • The v2 bank has no English, so each English scenario copies one v2 Hindi or Hinglish scenario: same industry, use case, difficulty, speaker and tests, rewritten as Indian English.
  • 56 of them have their v2 original in this plan too, so we can compare the same call in English and in Hindi–English.
  • The mix matches v2: 44 call-centre and 16 drama scenarios, with 5 Easy, 27 Medium and 28 Hard.
  • Amounts are written as Indian numerals (Rs 3,40,000), so each model has to choose to say “lakh” itself. Some codes are sent raw (KKBK0001234) instead of pre-spelled, as a real system would send them.

Voice cast

The same voices as the September runs: every woman is Matilda / Aoede, every man Eric / Charon, and the older man Bill / Fenrir so two-voice scenes have two distinct voices. ElevenLabs stock voices, so no voice slots are needed. Age is not voiced.

SpeakerAge bandGemini 3.8 voiceEleven v4 voiceElevenLabs voice idScenarios

Before the run

  • ElevenLabs characters: one round needs about 30,800 and two about 61,600. The two keys in voice/.env (first and second) have 10,000 a month each.
  • Gemini key: read from Secret Manager through studies-runner; needs a current gcloud login as chinnamnaidu@tilicho.in.
  • Short live test (about 16 clips): tags, two-voice scenes, Hindi and Telugu language codes, and one clip per voice by ear.
  • Open decision: fqc-hi-06 and trv-hi-04 have a 6 s minimum length that a quick correct read may miss.

Run commands

cd voice
set -a && . ./.env && set +a
.venv/bin/python -m runner.cli --modality voice \
  --scenarios scenarios-oct-2026 run --bundle \
  --label oct-p1 --budget 10
.venv/bin/python -m runner.cli --modality voice judge
.venv/bin/python -m runner.cli --modality voice report --open

Round 2, after round 1 is complete: the same run with --label oct-p2. About 45–60 minutes per pass (Gemini is limited to 10 requests a minute). Estimate $2.73 per pass at list price.

How the 200 image scenarios were picked

Not set up in the runner yet

The 200 image scenarios are picked and their full briefs are below, but Nano Banana 2.1 and GPT Image 2.5 (high) still need model entries in image/configs/models.yaml, and the v3 edits need 59 input images made first. The v2 edit inputs already exist on the scenario bank site.

One pair, one-to-one

GoogleOpenAIPrice per image
Nano Banana 2.1 NEWGPT Image 2.5, high quality$0.034 vs ~$0.053
  • Gaurav set this pair on the call: Nano Banana 2.1 (6 October) against GPT Image 2.5 at high quality, its matching price segment.
  • GPT Image 2.5 (8 September) is OpenAI’s newest image model. It comes in two API versions: Flare, the default, and Sunburst, slower and more precise. The call mentioned Sunburst, so which one we use is still to confirm.
  • The OpenAI price is a third-party figure for a 1024×1024 image. Check it against OpenAI’s own pricing page.
